components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: #4a5568; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74,85,104,0.5); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.8); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: #4a5568; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74,85,104,0.5); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline { background: rgba(55,65,81,0.3); border-color: #374151; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(55,65,81,0.5); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Removing keys or data. A red tint, not a solid block.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font: 500 14px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-destructive { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.2); color: #ef4444; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.3); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239,68,68,0.4); }

narrative.overview:
MetricFlow looks like a calm, dark control room. Surfaces are deep navy-black and stay quiet; the status colours light up only where a page needs attention. An engineer should be able to glance at a screen and see what is wrong before reading a word.

The mood is calm, precise, technical and friendly. It sits comfortably next to a terminal and an editor, uses exact numbers and tight alignment, and still reads easily for someone who is not an observability expert. Components are compact and restrained: small controls, flat panels, hairline edges.

The app is dark only. `<html>` carries the `dark` class permanently; the light values in `app/globals.css` are unused shadcn defaults, not a second theme.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only, on a navy-black base
System font stack; no web fonts are loaded
Flat panels edged with a hairline ring

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean healthy, warning and failing. They are never used as decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only non-status accent. Violet belongs to charts.

rules.name: The Title Entrance Rule
rules.body: Titles fade in and rise 8px once on mount (400ms, ease-out) through the `title-enter` utility. With reduced motion they render in their final state.

rules.name: The Ring-First Rule
rules.body: A new panel gets the hairline ring and no shadow. Add a shadow only when the surface floats above others.

dos: Do keep the app dark only, on Console Black.
Do use the theme tokens (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`) rather than raw hex.
Do keep controls at 32px and body text at 14px.
Do give new panels the hairline ring first (The Ring-First Rule).
Do wrap entrance motion in `motion-safe`, as `title-enter` does.
donts: Don't use green, amber or red for anything but status.
Don't add a second accent colour beside Signal Blue.
Don't load web fonts; the system stack is the type system.
Don't build a light theme from the unused `:root` values without deciding to.
